cards.name_on_card: The last time I was on a plane I wrote a song
cards.summary: small spiral-bound pocket notepad, pencil; unused black-and-white marbled Composition notebook
cards.typed_words: (1) Small pocket notebook, handwritten in pencil, an unfinished song fragment: "The last time I was on a plane I wrote a song / Since then nothing's gone right / And yet time stays the same / It just keeps marching on... / I blame myself for time / Time never pretends / Time chooses sides / To be anyone's friend" and, on a later page, "Then next time take a left / This time follow the sun / Rather than go chasing the night" (fragments, appear to be draft song lyrics; remaining notebook pages largely blank or with illegible pencil scrawl). (2) A separate unused black-and-white marbled COMPOSITION notebook (60 sheets/120 pages), completely blank - no writing.
